thread:
Alice M.: Heads-up — I'm planning to cut release/1.12 tomorrow morning. Need to confirm branch owner, final cutoff for cherry-picks, and the backport rules for this cycle.
Ben K.: I can own branch creation. Do we want an RC branch (release/1.12-rc1) or just release/1.12? Also, what's the exact cutoff?
Alice M.: Let's cut release/1.12 directly from main. Final cutoff for cherry-picks will be 18:00 PT today — anything after moves to the next release unless it's a security hotfix.
Dmitri R.: Backport policy reminder: only bug fixes that include tests and a brief QA reproduction step. No behavior-changing refactors or perf experiments unless product signs off. Security and data-loss fixes are exempt and should be flagged with `backport:urgent`.
Cara S.: Procedural notes: tag cherry-pick requests with the `release/cherry` label, include the original PR link and a one-sentence reason in the PR body. When you open the cherry-pick PR against release/1.12, put `cherry-pick of #<orig>` in the title.
Ben K.: Commands I'll run to create branch and push:
```
# create branch from main
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.12 origin/main
# push branch and open PR
git push -u origin release/1.12
```
I'll then open PR against origin/release/1.12 per branch protection rules.
deploy-bot: note — branch protection disallows direct pushes to release/*, require PR with 2 reviewers and passing CI.
Alice M.: Good call. Please add @Alice M. and @Cara S. as reviewers on the branch PR. I'll draft the initial release notes from the PR bodies and changelog bullets.
Ben K.: Also: version bump step — run the helper script `./scripts/update_version.py 1.12.0` and commit the changed files to the release branch so the package metadata and docs show the new version.
Cara S.: QA process: once cherry-picks land on the release branch, label them `qa/ready` and ping @QA Team. We'll prioritize smoke tests; only PRs that pass smoke get merged to release.
Dmitri R.: Infra note: please ensure any cherry-pick commits keep the original author and include the `-x` commit message reference when using `git cherry-pick`. It helps traceability.
Ben K.: If you need me to cherry-pick something right away, post the PR link here. I'll batch small bug backports to avoid re-triggering CI repeatedly.
Cara S.: Scanning bugfix queue now — will post a short list of candidates in this thread in 10m. :eyes:
Alice M.: Final confirmation — cutoff 18:00 PT. Branch owner Ben. Backports require tests + QA signoff except security. I'll assemble release notes and ping product for any notable callouts. Thanks everyone.
Ben K.: Branch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4901 — added reviewers and release checklist in the PR body.
QA Team: We'll start smoke runs when PRs are marked `qa/ready`. Schedule looks clear after branch cut.
Dmitri R.: From infra side we're green. Reminder: if you bump runtime deps in a cherry-pick, call out potential infra impacts in the PR body.
Ben K.: Copy. Closing loop — will merge approved cherry-picks into release/1.12 before EOD and post final changelog draft here.
